title: Torch of Revocation
summary: A +1 torch that can destroy a haunted painting and deal extra damage when lit.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple Light one-handed club. 5 ft melee. +1 to attacks. Hit for 1d4 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength. The source lists +1d4 Necrotic and +1d4 Fire, and identifies the dual riders as the lit profile.
fields.Exorcism: Use it on the Painting of a Smiling Maiden in Free the Artist. The encounter can grant Flames of Passion, True Exorcism or Using the Proper Means Inspiration.
fields.Acquisition: Quest reward from Mystic Carrion or the locked chest behind him.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
